hooks.logic:
Let v2 be the script register, then the acting enemy.
Count up "countForMegaFlare".
If condition flag v is up this frame, then reset the count "countForMegaFlare".
Run helper.
If the acting enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v3 be the count "countForMegaFlare".
  If v3 is more than len, then v2 uses the move labelled "megaflare" and stop.
  Let list2 be [].
  Let v4 be data at v3.
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of v2.
  Append {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: v4}]]}} to list2.
  Append {abilityId: ability} to list2.
  V2 uses ability with its cast time and then list2.

flow.text: Let v2 be the script register, then the acting enemy.
condition flag v is up this frame
the acting enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let v4 be data at v3.
Let ability be a smart-weighted move of v2.
Append {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: v4}]]}} to list2.
V2 uses ability with its cast time and then list2.

script_hooks.logic:
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
Let hpRate2 be the phase for the enemy under the phases list with HP fraction hpRate from phase the register's 'currBpIdx'.
If the register's 'currBpIdx' is not hpRate2, then
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list at hpRate2's 'paramSuffixNo' on the enemy.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  Set the register's 'currBpIdx' to hpRate2.

yes.text: Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list at hpRate2's 'paramSuffixNo' on the enemy.
The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
